descriptions.job-14uisdi:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

TradePMR is Robinhood's custody and technology platform for registered investment advisors (RIAs). Our integration ecosystem spans core technology partners, specialized workflow and TAMP partners, and a broader network of consultants, recruiters, and capital providers. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, Marketing, Business Development, and the tactical integrations team. It's a collaborative group focused on advisor success and on building partnerships that last!

The Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships & Integrations owns TradePMR's external-facing relationships with technology partners and advisor firms across the integration ecosystem. The tactical integrations team handles vendor onboarding, data feeds, and technical implementation. You'll decide which partnerships matter most and who we should build them with. You'll advise enterprise RIAs and breakaway teams, host partner events, negotiate special agreements, and equip our sales teams with accurate partner collateral. You'll also bring partner and client insight into integration roadmap discussions, shaping priorities through influence and input rather than build ownership. This is a business and partnerships role, not a product or engineering role, and your impact will show up in the strength of our advisor and partner relationships!

This role is based in our Tampa, FL and Clearwater, FLoffice(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Serve as a direct advisor to enterprise RIAs and breakaway teams evaluating custody transitions and platform fit
  • Own and run Transition Sandbox walkthroughs, live demo environments for prospective and transitioning firms
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for advisor firms navigating the TradePMR integration ecosystem
  • Build and maintain the Partner Resource Hub, including custodial comparison sheets, integration guides, and platform one-pagers
  • Equip Practice Management and Sales with current, accurate partner and integration collateral, and keep internal teams informed of live and upcoming integrations
  • Own and execute the Center of Influence (COI) engagement cadence, including monthly strategy touchpoints, quarterly briefings, and virtual executive roundtables
  • Stand up and run the COI Advisory Council, spanning consulting, technology, M&A, and recruiting
  • Directly own relationships with core technology partners and specialized workflow and TAMP partners
  • Coordinate with Marketing and Business Development on adjacent COI relationships, such as transition consultants, M&A advisors, capital providers, breakaway recruiters, and compliance consultants
  • Plan and represent TradePMR at flagship partner events, and own regional VIP dinners and executive roundtables, including guest lists, briefing content, and follow-up
  • Negotiate custom commercial terms with strategic partners, such as portfolio-wide custodial fee schedules, custom API reporting SLAs, and enterprise onboarding SLAs
  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Finance on sign-off for non-standard agreements, using a template-first approach and escalating to custom terms only where justified
  • Surface partner and client integration requests and pain points into Product and Engineering prioritization discussions
  • Represent the external partner and advisor-firm perspective in integration roadmap planning, and work with the tactical integrations team so strategic priorities turn into executed integrations

What you bring

  • 7+ years in partnerships, business development, or strategic account management, ideally in wealthtech, fintech, or RIA custodial and technology services
  • Demonstrated experience managing external relationships with technology vendors and/or advisor or client firms in a regulated financial services environment
  • Comfort serving as a primary external face for the organization, including event hosting, executive-level relationship management, and negotiation
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with Product, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, Marketing, and technical integrations teams
  • Familiarity with the RIA custodial technology landscape (portfolio management systems, CRM, TAMP, and financial planning tools) is a plus

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. descriptions.job-0pebtye:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is building the economic infrastructure that makes it easier for entrepreneurs and companies across the globe to grow their businesses. To support those efforts, Stripe is seeking a seasoned Government Relations professional to join our Government Relations & Public Affairs team in the US. Stripes on the Government Relations & Public Affairs team operate in a fast-paced internal and external environment that requires collaborating with teams across our organization and with outside stakeholders. The culture is thoughtful, transparent, academically rigorous, and kind. In this role you will have the opportunity to impact the trajectory of Stripe in the US and enhance financial innovation and inclusion. This role is focused on US federal legislative and regulatory advocacy and will sit alongside Stripe's existing federal team in Washington, DC.

What you’ll do

In this role you will deal with a diverse set of issues that straddle financial services, technology, internet regulation, tax and economic policy. You will define, shape, and advocate for initiatives that increase the GDP of the Internet. You will maintain deep relationships with Members of Congress, committee staff, key federal regulators, and the Executive Branch — building and executing legislative and regulatory strategies on issues central to Stripe's mission, including payments modernization, financial regulation, artificial intelligence, and the future of agentic commerce. If you are a team player who wants to represent millions of businesses around the world growing on Stripe, we look forward to hearing from you!

Responsibilities

  • Be a senior member of our Government Relations & Public Affairs team, which works across the globe to strategically develop, pursue, and execute policy objectives as part of Stripe's global policy priorities
  • Develop and execute federal legislative advocacy — managing Stripe's engagement with Congress on key legislative priorities including stablecoins, digital assets, open banking, AI governance, and payments regulation
  • Build and maintain relationships with Members of Congress, committee and personal staff, and serve as Stripe's frontline representative on federal legislation affecting the payments and technology industries
  • Engage federal regulatory agencies — including the Treasury Department, OCC, FDIC, Federal Reserve, CFPB, and others — to educate them about Stripe's business, advocate for sound policy outcomes, and navigate regulatory proceedings
  • Plan, develop, and execute political, policy and advocacy initiatives and campaigns that advance Stripe's policy goals and those of our users
  • Help colleagues across Stripe understand federal legislative and regulatory developments, identify policy opportunities to grow our business, and translate complex policy dynamics into actionable guidance
  • Represent Stripe on trade groups, coalitions, and industry bodies engaged on federal policy issues
  • Own internal budget management and reporting, including quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and regular performance reporting to leadership
  • Communicate with clarity and precision — producing internal and external written work that reflects Stripe's high bar for writing

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • At least 12+ years of experience in a policymaking, government, or senior advocacy role — ideally a mix of time on Capitol Hill, in a federal regulatory agency, or in a world-class organization as an in-house government relations expert or other business-related role
  • A background working for a Member of Congress, a committee or leadership office, or in a senior policy role at the US Treasury, OCC, FDIC, White House, or comparable federal institution — with a track record of navigating bipartisan legislative environments
  • Deep expertise in financial services regulation and payments policy, with a strong understanding of the legislative and regulatory landscape across banking, money transmission, and digital assets
  • Familiarity with, and ideally direct experience on, emerging technology policy — including artificial intelligence, agentic commerce, and the regulatory questions that arise at the intersection of AI and financial services
  • Strong relationships with policymakers and staff on both sides of the aisle and a reputation for credibility, reliability, and good judgment
  • A proven track record of managing complex, technical policy issues — capable of managing major initiatives independently, driving coalitions, or project managing a cross-functional team
  • Excellent judgment — capable of making smart decisions in the face of ambiguity and imperfect information and learning from them
  • A terrific communicator and writer, adept at working with lawyers, regulators, engineers, business teams, and colleagues to make complex concepts clear and understandable
  • Passion for Stripe's mission of helping businesses grow and thrive
  • A collaborative, curious team-first mindset with experience thriving in ambiguous, high-growth or startup environments across global offices.
  • Empathy, humility, and a respect for those who have views that are different from yours
  • A willingness to work with a diverse group of policy, regulatory, and product professionals who care deeply about Stripe's policy issues, our users, and each other
  • Willingness to travel 25% for meetings and events

About the team

Before Stripe, every growing internet platform needed a payments team. Today, every growing internet platform needs a way to establish trust in its users.

Identity verification is a core piece of economic infrastructure for online businesses. Stripe Identity enables businesses to digitally verify their users through identity documents and other signals for fraud prevention, regulatory, and trust and safety use cases. We are building the future of identity verification and trust in the digital economy.

The Identity Product Experience team owns Stripe Identity’s mobile SDKs for iOS, Android, and React Native. These SDKs enable businesses to embed secure, high-quality identity-verification experiences directly in their mobile applications. Our work spans mobile user experience, reusable SDK architecture, camera and document-capture experiences, developer experience, security, accessibility, reliability, and integration with Stripe’s backend systems.

  • Build mobile experiences that help establish trust between businesses and their users.
  • Solve challenging product and technical problems involving mobile platforms, sensitive data, fraud prevention, and global scale.
  • Create SDKs used by developers across industries, including fintech, marketplaces, and online platforms.
  • Help shape the future of digital identity and make verification easier, safer, and more accessible.

Our vision is to build the world’s most trusted store of verified identities, enabling frictionless identity verification across Stripe and beyond.

We’re looking for engineers who care deeply about mobile craft and the entire user journey. You should enjoy translating complex technical and regulatory requirements into simple, polished experiences; working through ambiguity; and learning new technologies and systems.

Join us to build mobile identity-verification experiences that businesses can integrate easily and that their users can trust.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

As an Android engineer on the Identity team, you will:

  • Design, build, and maintain Stripe Identity’s mobile SDKs and verification experiences across iOS, Android, and React Native.
  • Create intuitive, polished experiences for complex flows such as identity-document and selfie capture, while accounting for accessibility, device capabilities, and varied real-world conditions.
  • Build reliable and extensible SDK APIs and reusable components that make it easy for developers to integrate Stripe Identity into their applications.
  • Work across mobile clients, supporting APIs, and services to deliver features end to end rather than treating the mobile application as an isolated layer.
  • Improve SDK performance, reliability, observability, testing, release processes, and backward compatibility.
  • Make thoughtful architectural decisions that balance user experience, developer experience, security, privacy, and long-term maintainability.
  • Partner closely with product managers, designers, machine-learning engineers, backend engineers, user researchers, and other mobile teams.
  • Work with Stripe users and field teams to understand integration challenges and turn their feedback into product and platform improvements.
  • Help establish and evolve mobile-engineering practices across Identity and Stripe.
  • Operate and maintain the systems and SDKs the team owns, including diagnosing production issues and improving them based on what we learn.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software-development experience, including meaningful experience building and shipping mobile applications or SDKs.
  • Experience developing for at least one major mobile platform using technologies such as Kotlin or Java for Android.
  • Strong software-design fundamentals and experience creating maintainable APIs, components, or frameworks.
  • Experience delivering mobile functionality beyond an isolated UI layer for example, integrating with APIs and services, handling local state, or working with device capabilities.
  • Experience testing, debugging, monitoring, and improving mobile software in production.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, design, and other technical and non-technical partners.
  • A demonstrated commitment to building high-quality user and developer experiences.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building mobile SDKs, shared libraries, or developer-facing APIs used outside your immediate team.
  • Experience with both iOS and Android, or with cross-platform technologies such as React Native or Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Experience with camera, image-processing, document-capture, biometrics, or other device-integrated mobile experiences.
  • Experience designing mobile software that handles sensitive data and applies security and privacy principles by default.
  • Familiarity with accessibility, internationalization, mobile performance, and unreliable network conditions.
  • Experience with mobile CI, automated testing, release automation, observability, or developer-productivity tooling.
  • Experience contributing to backend APIs or services that support mobile products.
  • Ability to simplify complex requirements and favor durable, scalable solutions.
  • Comfort reasoning clearly and moving with urgency in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
  • Familiarity with Stripe’s products, ideally through integrating Stripe APIs or SDKs into another application.

This is a critical leadership appointment, responsible for establishing and maintaining a strong UK-regulated business while supporting BVNK's broader ambition to transform global money movement through stablecoin and payment infrastructure.

You will work closely with the Board, UK senior management and wider BVNK and Mastercard leadership to ensure the business operates effectively within its regulatory permissions and maintains appropriate local decision-making authority.

You will be expected to lead engagement with the FCA throughout the authorisation process and establish a sustainable, commercially successful and well-controlled regulated business.

  • Provide overall executive leadership of BVNK UK, with accountability for its strategy, commercial performance, governance and regulatory obligations.
  • Lead the UK entity through the FCA authorisation process, acting as a key point of contact for regulatory engagement, assessments and interviews.
  • Establish and maintain effective UK-based governance, ensuring appropriate decision-making authority, management oversight and accountability within the regulated entity.

  • Lead the implementation and ongoing oversight of Consumer Duty requirements where applicable to the firm's regulated activities.
  • Work closely with Compliance, Risk, Finance and Operations to establish an effective three lines of defence model, with clear responsibilities, appropriate independence and robust escalation arrangements.
  • Maintain effective oversight of material risks, ensuring the Board receives appropriate management information and that significant regulatory or operational issues are escalated promptly.

  • Build and lead a high-performing UK senior management team, promoting a culture of accountability, integrity, customer protection and regulatory compliance.
  • Represent BVNK UK with regulators, strategic partners and other key stakeholders.

  • Significant senior executive leadership experience within a UK-regulated financial services business, ideally having previously held an FCA-approved SMF1 or SMF3 position.
  • Demonstrable experience running or holding substantial executive accountability within a regulated entity, including engagement with the FCA and responsibility for regulatory governance.

  • Sound knowledge of prudential requirements, including capital and liquidity adequacy, fixed overhead requirements, financial resource planning, stress testing and wind-down planning.
  • Understanding of Consumer Duty requirements, financial promotions and the associated governance and oversight expectations.
  • Experience developing and executing commercial strategies while maintaining effective regulatory controls and financial discipline.
  • Demonstrable ability to lead cross-functional senior management teams and oversee complex operational, financial and regulatory activities.
  • Strong understanding of risk management frameworks, governance structures and the three lines of defence model.
  • Experience working within a wider group structure, with the ability to balance group strategy and shared services with local regulatory accountability.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the confidence and credibility to engage directly with regulators, Board members and senior executives.
  • Ability to demonstrate the fitness and propriety standards required for FCA Senior Manager approval, including honesty, integrity, competence, capability and financial soundness.
  • Willingness and ability to be based in the UK on a full-time basis, providing effective local leadership and regulatory oversight.

  • Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
  • A culture built on passionate, growth-minded people
  • A flexible approach to holiday
  • Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world
  • An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets

At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.

Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:

  • CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
  • FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
  • Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
  • LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

About this role in the team:

We are seeking a UK Compliance Manager to oversee regulatory compliance for our UK Electronic Money Institution. 

This role sits within our 2nd line of defence, maintaining the compliance monitoring framework, firm-wide policies, overseeing safeguarding and conduct rules, and reviewing financial promotions. Your primary focus will be the UK, but, as part of a global team, you will get the opportunity to support other regions and company-wide initiatives.

Key Areas of Responsibility:

  • UK Regulatory Compliance Framework: Operationalise and maintain the firm’s compliance policies and procedures in strict alignment with the applicable regulators and the FCA Handbook (SYSC, SUP, CASS/Safeguarding, DISP, and Consumer Duty).
  • Horizon Scanning: Track evolving UK regulatory developments.
  • Senior Management & Board Reporting: Prepare regulatory compliance reporting packs, KPIs, and compliance monitoring outcomes for the Head of Compliance, Executive Risk Committees, and Board of Directors.
  • FCA Regulatory Engagement: Assist with regulatory notifications and periodic regulatory returns.
  • Operational Resilience: Collaborate with IT and Operations to ensure compliance with operational resilience frameworks, business continuity plans (BCP), and third-party outsourcing requirements.
  • Consumer Duty: Monitor product design, customer journeys, price and value assessments, and customer support channels to ensure alignment with FCA Consumer Duty outcomes.
  • Financial Promotions Sign-Off: Serve as the designated compliance approver for all marketing materials, advertising campaigns, website content, and social media promotions targeting UK retail customers.
  • Complaints Handling Oversight: Oversee the 2nd Line review of customer complaints handling processes, ensuring compliance with DISP rules and root-cause analysis reporting to prevent systemic issues.
  • Regulatory Advisory: Act as the primary regulatory compliance Subject Matter Expert (SME) for product, engineering, and commercial teams launching new payment features, APIs, stablecoin capabilities, or digital asset services in the UK.
  • New license applications: Support any future application for the UK’s new cryptoasset regulatory regime.

What we need from you:

  • Experience: Relevant experience in a similar compliance role within financial services (preferably in a  fintech or crypto firm)
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business or a related discipline
  • Professional Qualifications: Preferably at least one recognised professional compliance qualification (e.g. ICA)

What you can expect from us:

  • Fair and competitive salary at every stage of your growth
  • Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
  • A culture built on passionate, growth-minded people
  • A flexible approach to holiday
  • Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world
  • An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets

At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.
descriptions.job-16xa15y:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Works in Progress is Stripe's magazine of new and underrated ideas to improve the world. We publish an eclectic mix of articles on policy, economics, business, technology, science, history, arts and culture, published online and in print. We have a fast-growing global audience, primarily in tech, finance and politics, and we are building out the team across editorial, design, operations and commercial.

What you’ll do

This is an entry-level commercial role for a recent graduate who is ambitious, organised and excited to learn quickly in a small, entrepreneurial team.

You will work closely with the Director of Commercial and Audiovisual across the magazine’s commercial activity: advertising, subscriptions, events, marketing and partnerships. You will help keep commercial projects moving by conducting research, supporting outreach, maintaining pipelines and trackers, following up with prospective partners, and contributing to growth experiments.

You will learn by doing: writing outbound emails, building target lists, preparing materials, tracking results, joining calls and following up consistently. It is a strong opportunity for someone who wants early exposure to senior commercial work and meaningful responsibility from the start of their career.

Responsibilities

  • Support the advertising sales process, including preparing rate cards, pitch decks, outreach and pipeline materials.
  • Research and build target lists of potential advertisers, sponsors, agencies, founders, investors and partners.
  • Draft clear, thoughtful outbound emails and follow-ups.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, commercial trackers and reporting.
  • Support subscription growth through acquisition and retention ideas, and help measure their effectiveness.
  • Help develop the events business, including sponsor research, partnership outreach and event planning support.
  • Assist with early marketing and growth experiments across paid acquisition, referrals, partnerships, direct mail and audience development.
  • Prepare decks, reports and briefing materials that help commercial conversations move forward.
  • Join meetings and calls with clients, partners and agencies, taking notes and supporting follow-up.
  • Help turn commercial ideas into clear proposals with pricing, positioning and next steps.
  • Work across sales, marketing, events and subscriptions, adapting quickly as priorities evolve.
  • Take on the practical, sometimes unglamorous work needed to help a small business grow.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Is a recent graduate, or has equivalent early-career experience.
  • Is excited by commercial work and motivated by helping ideas turn into revenue.
  • Is interested in sales, marketing, partnerships, media, events or business development.
  • Is highly organised and comfortable managing lists, trackers and multiple follow-ups.
  • Is numerate and confident using spreadsheets.
  • Is a sharp, clear writer who can communicate professionally over email and in presentations.
  • Is proactive, resilient and comfortable reaching out to people they do not know.
  • Is curious, resourceful and willing to learn quickly.
  • Enjoys working in a small team where everyone pitches in.
  • Is comfortable with both high-profile opportunities and repetitive operational work, such as researching prospects and following up on outreach.
  • Has an interest in media, publishing, technology, economics, policy or culture. Previous media or publishing experience is helpful but not required.

Working at Works in Progress

This role is based in London and requires working from the office every day. You will be part of a small, ambitious team that cares deeply about the magazine and its growth. In return, you will get a steep learning curve, close mentorship and the chance to contribute directly to building the commercial future of Works in Progress.
descriptions.job-1jk86li:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM is hiring a Strategic Finance Lead, R&D and AI to help decide how the company invests in AI, cloud and compute infrastructure, and the engineering capacity behind its products. You'll be the dedicated finance partner to the CTO and R&D leadership, turning complex usage, billing, and headcount data into recommendations that shape major investment decisions before they're made. Reporting to Pharoah Green, Head of Strategic Finance and FP&A, within the FP&A and Strategic Finance Business Partnership function, you'll design the financial architecture for R&D from the ground up, with AI built into how the work gets done.

The impact you will have:

  • Shape how TRM invests in AI, cloud, and compute by building an AI-assisted, driver-based economic model that connects usage and billing data across hundreds of SKUs to forecasts and decisions.

  • Lower R&D costs as a % of revenue without slowing product velocity, using AI to surface optimization opportunities in infrastructure spend and partnering with Engineering to act on them.

  • Define TRM's AI spend strategy with the Head of AI, using AI-powered analysis to track spend against ROI by tool and workload and to recommend where to commit, consolidate, or build.

  • Give R&D leaders an early view of change by owning planning, forecasting, and the headcount capacity model, with automated workflows that flag risks while there is still time to act.

  • Influence major infrastructure and R&D commitments by leading investment cases from business case to decision to measurement, with AI-assisted scenario analysis that makes tradeoffs clear.

  • Turn R&D performance into a clear executive and board narrative: what changed, why, and which decisions should follow.

  • Rebuild R&D finance around AI, automation, and Pigment so more time goes to shaping decisions and less to assembling reports.

What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years across strategic finance, FP&A, business operations, or a related role. We care more about the complexity you've owned and the influence you've had than an exact number of years.

  • A record of owning consequential work end to end: framing an ambiguous question, structuring the analysis, forming a point of view, and driving a recommendation to action.

  • Strong data-informed modeling skills, including driver-based forecasts, investment cases, and capacity models built from incomplete or complex data, accelerated with AI.

  • Hands-on experience analyzing cloud, compute, AI, or other usage-based technology costs, and experience partnering with Engineering, Product, Data, AI, or Infrastructure leaders.

  • The judgment and communication skills to become a trusted partner to senior technical leaders, challenge assumptions constructively, and explain financial implications in plain language.

  • Applied AI fluency: you can show how you've used AI to improve the speed or quality of modeling, research, or recurring workflows, and how you check the reliability of its output.

  • Curiosity to learn technical systems quickly and translate how AI products and modern infrastructure scale into financial insight.

About the Team:

  • Strategic Finance is a small, high-leverage team that works directly with TRM's leadership on planning, investment decisions, and company-wide strategy.

  • Our job isn't just to explain the numbers. We collaborate with leaders to make better decisions, and we hold a high bar for rigor and trust in our work.

  • You'll have substantial ownership from day one, direct exposure to the CTO and executive team, and room to shape how R&D finance operates.

  • The role is built to scale with its owner. Using AI and automation, you can expand what one person owns, and as the mandate grows there may be an opportunity to build a team.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • We're distributed, not distant: written communication for clarity and context, live time for decisions and collaboration.

  • Regular working sessions with the CTO and R&D leaders, plus a monthly R&D cost and forecast review.

  • Quarterly planning with Talent and R&D on headcount capacity, and annual planning cycles in Pigment.

  • Slack and Notion for async updates; AI tools are part of the daily workflow.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within your first 30 days, deliver an initial AI-assisted cloud forecast, focused on GCP with AWS coverage as applicable, that gives R&D leaders their first driver-based view of where infrastructure spend is heading.

  • Within your first 60 days, put a defined AI spend strategy in front of the CTO, with a clear recommendation on where to commit, consolidate, or cut.

  • Within your first 90 days, have the R&D capacity model integrated into the planning process so hiring decisions and budget move together.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.
